terminals.name: firestore-emulator
terminals.command: export CLOUDSDK_CORE_DISABLE_PROMPTS=1 && exec "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gcloud" emulators firestore start --host-port=127.0.0.1:8090

terminals.name: go-server
terminals.command: export PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH" && for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8090 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done && cd server && export LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN="${LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN:-dev-placeholder-token}" GCP_PROJECT_ID="${GCP_PROJECT_ID:-qrurl-local}" FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST="127.0.0.1:8090" && exec go run main.go

terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.command: cd client && exec npm run dev
